game.title: Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition
game.blurb: Fighting game from NetherRealm Studios and High Voltage Software, published by Warner Bros. Interactive, released 2013-07-03. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Arcade, Fighting. Chapters follow the modes named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Story Mode and Training
chapters.summary: Story Mode at 50% and 100%, the Tutorial and the Fatality Trainer.

chapters.title: Arcade Ladder
chapters.summary: Arcade and Tag Ladders, max difficulty, no-block runs and the four Hidden Kombatants.

chapters.title: Online and Versus
chapters.summary: Versus matches, online and ranked wins, King of the Hill respect and streaks.

chapters.title: Challenge Tower and Minigames
chapters.summary: Tower missions and the Test Your Might, Strike, Sight and Luck minigames.

chapters.title: The Krypt and Unlocks
chapters.summary: Unlocking the Krypt, alternate costumes and hidden fighters.

chapters.title: Fighters and Finishers
chapters.summary: Fatalities, X-Ray attacks, throws, Tag Combos, mastery and hidden finishing moves.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 237110)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Mortal_Kombat_(2011)
Fandom (mortalkombat.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://mortalkombat.fandom.com/wiki/Mortal_Kombat_(2011_video_game)
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 17599). App 237110 comes from RAWG's own Steam store link for this entry; it is not in the current Steam store app list, but the Steam Web API still returns its achievement schema (with a blank game name) and global percentages. 0 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden. StrategyWiki redirects "Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition" to "Mortal Kombat (2011)" (completion stage 0): Achievements and trophies, Characters, Moves (about 221,000 characters) and Table of Contents are written; Walkthrough and the sixteen story chapter pages are linked but not written. mortalkombat.fandom.com has no page under "Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition"; "Mortal Kombat (2011)" redirects to "Mortal Kombat (2011 video game)", with about 286 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Test Your Luck was grouped with the other Test Your minigames.
